sections.heading: style-117 Holographic Scanline Illustration — 3 s silent preview

children.value:
Subject: an idea becomes a connected system. 1280x720, 30 fps, 3 s, silent.
Renderer: Canvas 2D (Path2D cached, clipped 1px scanlines, cyan 3px + white 1px contours, stationary faint cyan grid). Motion: GSAP paused timeline owning a state object; render(state) on every update and hf-seek.
Palette: #07080A background (opaque clear each frame), #45F0DD lines/contours, #FFFFFF cores and title.

rows.Beat: Idea circle contour draws (setLineDash length progress). Headers and title are standalone and visible throughout.
Scanlines sweep top-to-bottom inside the circle; inner denser block follows; solid core block steps in at 1.0–1.25 s.
IDEA label (data-reveal-after="idea-frame") appears only after the circle contour and core are complete.
Eight links draw outward from the idea and around the perimeter.
Sparse system-field scanlines wipe in behind the links.
Four hex nodes draw contours, then fill with scanlines.
Density modulation: core brightens (denser), energy passes to nodes and field, then settles.

children.value: No arrows are used. No shadowBlur, bloom, particles, clocks or randomness.
